images.caption: Tromsø Cathedral (Tromsø domkirke) is a cathedral in the city of Tromsø.  The cathedral is part of the Tromsø domkirke parish and it is the episcopal seat of the Diocese of Nord-Hålogaland in the Church of Norway.
